baseline.method: Synthetic PHI injected into de-identified notes; leakage-recall = fraction of injected values absent from the pseudonymized output, per PHI type. UPPER BOUND (synthetic-in-slot is easier than organic PHI; TCGA is already de-identified). Ground-truth real-note recall needs gold-annotated data (i2b2/n2c2, DUA-gated). 'Absent' is a leakage proxy, not span-level detection.
